method_summary: This selector uses pivot-based clustering to improve diversity: it samples pivots weighted by uncertainty, assigns each point to its nearest pivot, then selects the highest-quality candidate from each of the top-k pivots, ensuring coverage of distinct feature regions while prioritizing uncertain pairs near the decision boundary. This replaces the sequential greedy farthest-first traversal with a single nearest-pivot assignment, making it more efficient and less prone to myopic local optima.
